description:
Employment Type: Full-Time

Role Overview

The Senior Manager/Manager – TPRM Governance will lead the strategic design, operationalization, and ongoing oversight of the enterprise-wide Third-Party Risk Management framework. 

This role is responsible for identifying, assessing, monitoring, and mitigating third-party risks across all vendors, suppliers, and partners. 

The person will champion the TPRM framework as aligned to applicable compliances across regulations and statutory mandates—while serving as the primary bridge between cross-functional business units, executive leadership, internal and external stakeholders.

TPRM Framework & Policy Governance

Establish robust governance mechanisms and the end-to-end design for formulating, executing, and enhancing TPRM control frameworks, policies, and standard operating procedures.

Ensure enterprise-wide adoption of third-party risk methodologies, aligning with applicable regulatory requirements.

Design, consolidate, and present executive TPRM dashboards, trend analyses, and exception reports directly to the Risk Management Committee, Board of Directors, and Senior leadership.

Third-Party Risk Assessment

Lead and oversee continuous vendor risk evaluations across multiple domains, including financial health, information security, operational resilience, legal, compliance, and reputational risk.

Maintain and govern a centralized, risk-tiered vendor inventory categorizing third parties based on service nature, data access, regulatory criticality, and concentration risk.

Define periodic due diligence and monitoring frequencies aligned with organizational risk appetite and regulatory standards.

Lead the ongoing monitoring strategy for critical third parties, utilizing SLA performance tracking, continuous financial health reviews, threat intelligence feeds, and regulatory sanction screening.

Manage and orchestrate structured, periodic vendor risk questionnaire assessments and remediation programs as defined under the TPRM framework.

Track vendor incidents, operational control failures, and risk events to drive remediation, while maintaining up-to-date policies, SOPs, risk registers, and governance reporting.

Industry Expertise: 6+ years of domain experience in Third-Party Risk Management, including Outsourcing Risk, Vendor Evaluation, Operational Risk, or Risk Governance within BFSI, FinTech, or a regulated environment.

Vendor & Operational Oversight: Demonstrated expertise in 3rd Party due diligence, SLA governance, regulatory compliances, and audit support for key third parties

title: Taxation
description:
Manager – Taxation & Finance

Location: Mumbai, India
Experience: 4–8 Years
Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA) Preferred

About the Role :

We are looking for a dynamic and detail-oriented professional to join our Finance team as Manager – Taxation & Finance. The role is responsible for managing the Company's direct and indirect tax compliance, tax accounting, regulatory reporting, audits, and litigation while partnering with cross-functional teams to drive finance transformation and process improvements.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Direct Tax, GST, tax accounting, ERP systems, and financial reporting, along with the ability to support strategic finance initiatives.

Key Responsibilities-

1. Direct & Indirect Tax Compliance
Manage end-to-end Direct Tax and GST compliance, including:
Return filing
Tax payments
Reconciliations
Statutory reporting
Ensure timely deduction, deposit, and reporting of TDS, TCS, and other applicable taxes.
Review tax implications of new products, business initiatives, contracts, and transactions.
Coordinate with tax consultants, statutory auditors, and regulatory authorities.
Support tax assessments, audits, notices, and litigation by preparing responses and maintaining documentation.
Monitor changes in tax laws and regulations and evaluate their impact on the business.

2. Tax Accounting & Financial Reporting
Ensure accurate accounting of:
Current Tax
Deferred Tax
GST
Other statutory levies
Review tax-related ledger balances and reconciliations.
Support preparation and review of financial statements from a taxation perspective.
Ensure tax provisions comply with applicable Accounting Standards, IND AS, and regulatory requirements.

3. Process Improvement & Tax Governance
Strengthen tax governance through robust SOPs, documentation, and internal controls.
Drive automation of tax compliance, reconciliations, and reporting processes.
Collaborate with ERP and Technology teams to enhance tax configurations and system capabilities.
Ensure tax-related master data and ERP configurations remain compliant with applicable regulations.
Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and compliance across tax processes.

4. Finance Operations & Cross-functional Support
Support month-end and year-end financial closing activities.
Participate in finance transformation, ERP implementation, automation, and process improvement initiatives.
Assist in preparation of MIS reports, management dashboards, and board or regulatory submissions.
Partner with Accounting, Treasury, Business, and Compliance teams on finance-related initiatives and projects.
Provide support on accounting, treasury, regulatory reporting, and other finance functions as required.

5. Audit & Regulatory Compliance
Support Internal Audit, Statutory Audit, Tax Audit, and regulatory inspections.
Ensure timely closure of tax and audit observations.
Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all tax-related transactions and compliance activities.
Ensure adherence to applicable tax laws, accounting standards, and internal governance policies.
Candidate Profile
Education
Chartered Accountant (CA) preferred
Additional qualifications in Finance or Taxation will be an advantage

Experience - 
4–8 years of relevant experience in:
Direct Tax
GST
Tax Accounting
Finance & Regulatory Compliance
- Experience in Financial Services, FinTech, Broking, NBFC, or Banking will be preferred.

The successful candidate will be expected to:

Ensure zero material tax compliance defaults or regulatory penalties.
Deliver timely and accurate Direct Tax, GST, and TDS/TCS compliance.
Successfully manage tax notices, assessments, and litigation matters.
Maintain accurate tax provisioning and reconciliations.
Ensure timely closure of audit observations and regulatory actions.
Drive automation and continuous improvement in tax processes.
Contribute effectively to finance transformation and cross-functional initiatives.

Location
Mumbai, India

Candidates based in Mumbai or willing to relocate are encouraged to apply.

title: Treasury
description:
Location: Mumbai, India
Experience: 8–10 Years
Qualification: CA / MBA (Finance) / CFA or equivalent

About the Role-

We are looking for an experienced Treasury professional to join our Corporate Treasury & Capital Markets team. The role will be responsible for managing the organization's funding, liquidity, banking relationships, capital market borrowings, treasury operations, and regulatory compliance while ensuring efficient cash management and optimal utilization of financial resources.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in debt capital markets, corporate treasury operations, banking relationships, SAP, and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities
1. Capital Markets & Debt Management
Structure, execute, and manage short-term and long-term debt instruments including:
Commercial Papers (CPs)
Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs)
Term Loans
Coordinate with credit rating agencies, merchant bankers, debenture trustees, institutional investors, and lending banks.
Support fund-raising initiatives and debt optimization strategies.
Manage security creation, charge filings (ROC/CERSAI), and all related financing documentation.
Monitor debt portfolio, repayment schedules, and borrowing costs.

2. Treasury Investments & Liquidity Management
Manage daily liquidity and cash positioning across all bank accounts.
Optimize deployment of surplus funds through:
Money Market Instruments
Mutual Funds
Fixed Income Investments
Prepare and monitor daily cash flow and liquidity reports.
Develop and enhance working capital and cash flow forecasting models.
Ensure efficient allocation of funds while minimizing idle cash balances.

3. Banking Relationships & Treasury Operations
Manage strategic relationships with banks and financial institutions.
Negotiate banking facilities, pricing, and credit limits.
Oversee Corporate Banking platforms including:
Host-to-Host (H2H)
Cash Management Services (CMS)
Online Banking Portals
Administer banking access controls, user rights, and signatory matrix updates.
Manage payment gateways, collection accounts, and treasury-related banking operations.
Coordinate bank confirmations and documentation for internal, statutory, and regulatory audits.

4. Treasury Accounting, MIS & Reporting
Ensure accurate accounting of treasury transactions in SAP (FICO/TRM).
Process accounting entries relating to:
Interest Accruals
Loan Repayments
Borrowing Costs
Treasury Transactions
Prepare treasury MIS and dashboards covering:
Debt Portfolio
Liquidity Position
Interest Cost
Yield Performance
Risk Metrics
Present treasury reports and insights to senior leadership.

5. Regulatory Compliance & Governance
Ensure compliance with Corporate Treasury policies and recommend continuous process improvements.
Stay updated with:
RBI Guidelines
FEMA Regulations
KYC Requirements
Treasury-related regulatory changes
Ensure timely regulatory filings and compliance related to treasury activities.
Manage ROC and CERSAI charge registrations and related documentation.

Candidate Profile

-Education :
Chartered Accountant (CA)
MBA in Finance
CFA
Or equivalent postgraduate qualification in Finance

-Experience
8–10 years of post-qualification experience in:
Corporate Treasury
Capital Markets
Banking or Financial Institutions


Location :
Mumbai, India

Candidates based in Mumbai or willing to relocate are encouraged to apply.

description:

title: Zonal Collection Manager- Bangalore - lending Collections
description:
Job Title: Zonal Collection Manager

About the Team:
The Collections team is responsible for managing overdue accounts, driving recovery performance, monitoring collection agencies and in-house teams, and ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory guidelines and the Code of Conduct. The team focuses on achieving collection targets, improving recovery efficiency, and minimizing credit losses across assigned territories.

About the Role:
The Zonal Collection Manager will be responsible for driving collection performance across the assigned zone, managing regional and branch-level collection teams, and ensuring the achievement of business and recovery targets. The role requires strong leadership, strategic planning, stakeholder management, and expertise in managing collection agencies and field operations while maintaining regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities:
Drive and achieve zonal collection targets across assigned products, branches, and delinquency buckets.
Develop and implement effective collection strategies to improve recovery rates, reduce roll-forwards, and control delinquencies.
Lead, manage, and monitor regional collection managers, branch teams, field executives, and collection agencies.
Review collection performance through regular MIS, productivity reports, and portfolio analysis, and take corrective actions wherever required.
Monitor collection agency performance, ensure optimal resource utilization, and drive accountability for assigned targets.
Ensure strict adherence to applicable RBI guidelines, regulatory requirements, internal policies, and the Code of Conduct.
Identify and control fraudulent practices, operational risks, and process gaps across collection operations.
Work closely with business, credit, risk, legal, and operations teams to resolve collection challenges and improve recovery outcomes.
Manage escalations related to overdue accounts, customer grievances, and field collection activities.
Ensure effective allocation of collection resources across branches and territories based on portfolio size, delinquency levels, and business requirements.
Drive employee productivity, performance reviews, capability building, and continuous improvement across the zonal team.
Prepare and present periodic collection performance updates, recovery forecasts, and action plans to senior management.

Skills and Competencies:
Strong expertise in collections, recovery management, and delinquency control.
Excellent leadership and team management skills, with the ability to manage large, geographically distributed teams.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with proficiency in collection MIS and performance tracking.
Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Strong understanding of collection processes, agency management, and applicable regulatory guidelines.
Ability to drive results, manage escalations, and deliver targets in a high-performance environment.
Strong planning, execution, and decision-making capabilities.
Proficiency in MS Excel, reporting tools, and collection management systems.
A proactive approach to process improvement, operational efficiency, and risk mitigation.

Education and Experience:
Education: Graduate in any discipline. Postgraduate qualifications will be an added advantage.

Experience: 10+ years of relevant experience in collections and recovery management, preferably in banking, NBFCs, fintech, or financial services.
Prior experience in managing zonal or multi-location collection operations, large teams, and collection agencies is preferred.

Compensation:
Compensation will be commensurate with the candidate’s experience, expertise, and suitability for the role.
